name: Nutty Brownie Bars
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 10 miniature chocolate coconut candy bars, chopped

steps: Prepare brownie mix according to package directions, reducing oil to 3 tbsp
Spread condensed milk over the brownie batter.
Sprinkle with chopped nuts and candy bars.
Bake at 350°F for 35–38 minutes or until done.
Cool completely and cut into bars.
